prompt: A commercial property generates annual net operating income of $180,000. Similar properties in the area have recently sold at capitalization rates of 6%. The estimated value of the property using the income approach is:
explanation: Using the income capitalization approach: Value = NOI / Cap rate = $180,000 / 0.06 = $3,000,000. Option B ($10,800,000) results from multiplying NOI by the cap rate rather than dividing: $180,000 × 60 = $10,800,000. Option C ($1,080,000) appears to apply an incorrect multiplier. The capitalization rate compresses the income stream into a value: lower cap rates imply higher property values (like lower required yields on bonds), and vice versa.
